title: What time do tickets go on presale today for KPop Demon Hunters Golden Word Tour 2027 - Yahoo News UK
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage What time do tickets go on presale today for KPop Demon Hunters Golden Word Tour 2027
 Jenna Campbell Wed, 18 November 2026 at 5:49 am UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. -Credit:Reach Publishing Services Limited This week tickets for the hotly anticipated KPop Demon Hunters Golden World Tour 2027 will officially go on sale. Organisers are billing it as "a next-generation K-pop concert experience unlike anything fans have seen, heard, or felt before".
 Launching across the globe in June 2027, the tour will arrive in the UK in October 2027, stopping in Glasgow at OVO Hydro on Thursday 14 October; Birmingham for two shows (matinee and evening) at Utilita Arena Birmingham on Saturday 16 October; Manchester at AO Arena on Tuesday 19 October; and London for three shows (matinee and evening on Saturday) at The O2 on Friday 22 October and Saturday 23 October.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement More than a virtual gig though, this is a first-of-its-kind production that immerses fans in the storytelling with live-action stunts and performers, fan-favorite music and choreography, and special performances.
 KPop Demon Hunters girl group HUNTR/X are going on tour -Credit:Courtesy of Netflix
 Powered by songs from Netflix's most popular film of all time, beloved animated HUNTR/X characters – Rumi, Mira and Zoey – will interact with the audience through cutting-edge performance innovations that bring this fan-favourite K-pop girl group to life like never before. This also includes animated characters of the Saja Boys and Derpy Tiger.
 HUNTR/X have a number of chart-topping singles including Golden, Soda Pop and How It's Done. Their breakout song 'Golden' became the first K-pop track to win both an Oscar and a Grammy.
 The film also earned the record for the first soundtrack in the United States' Billboard Hot 100 chart to feature four of its songs in the top ten at the same time. The animated hit film broke records when it was released on the streaming platform last summer, as it became Netflix's most-watched original movie of all time with more than 670 million views.
 Audrey Nuna, EJAE and Rei Ami, the vocalists behind Kpop Demon Hunters' HUNTR/X -Credit:Brit Awards
 With the first tour stops spanning North America, the UK and Europe, and additional international dates for Asia Pacific and Latin America regions coming soon, the tour will visit nearly 50 cities with more than 150 performances across 2027 and 2028
 What time is presale?
 Mastercard presale begins Wednesday 18 November at 10am local time.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement FOR THE FANS Presale begins Thursday 19 November at 10 a.m. local time.
 Tickets go on sale to the general public Friday 20 November at 10am local time. When general sale tickets go on sale on Friday, The Mastercard Collection gives eligible World Elite and World Legend cardholders access to Preferred Tickets, including some of the best seats in the house, though access varies by card type.
 Additionally, a limited number of exclusive VIP experiences and packages will be available. These exclusive offers can include an amazing selection of reserved seated tickets, on-stage photo opportunities, limited-edition memorabilia, preshow parties, custom merchandise and more! For more information, visit the KPop Demon Hunter's tour page here .
 UK tour dates
 Tuesday 12 October 2027 – OVO Hydro, Glasgow
 Saturday 16 October 2027 – Utilita Arena Birmingham (matinee)
 Saturday 16 October 2027 – Utilita Arena Birmingham (evening)
 Tuesday 19 October 2027 – AO Arena, Manchester
 Friday 22 October 2027 – The O2, London
 Saturday 23 October 2027 – The O2, London (matinee)
 Saturday 23 October 2027 – The O2, London (evening)
